{{Top|leg}}
The '''central ladderwell''', also known as '''quad-laser access tube''', was a tubular passageway on board the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] that ran through the center of the ship to access the ventral and dorsal [[AG-2G quad laser cannon/Legends|AG-2G quad laser cannon]] turrets. A ladder led both up and down between the two cannons.
